scope: Offline diagnostic step; no selection/scoring/threshold change, hosted calls or production mutation.

methodology.scope: Authored PDFs with synthetic distractors; warm local models and in-memory Qdrant brute-force search.
limitations: No hosted ANN, HTTP, concurrency, PostgreSQL, or LLM generation benchmark.
Page-label precision is not human-verified passage relevance or generated-answer accuracy.
Source fragments are checked by exact text presence, not semantic correctness.
Validation cases were used to diagnose identifier failures; fresh held-out authored cases are separate and not independently annotated.
One warm sequential run per case; not a concurrency, uptime, or production-scale guarantee.

known_regressions.question: What must I understand directly before HTTPS?
Why cannot a PostgreSQL rollback remove partial Qdrant writes?
Why must vector retrieval use the same document scope as access control?
Why does a signed login session still need authorization checks for each document?

results.question: Contrast the identity checks in a TLS certificate with authorization checks on a private PDF.
Compare what SQL transactions roll back with how compensating cleanup removes partial Qdrant writes.
Compare DNS cache expiry with the no-store directive for HTTP responses.

limits: Local MiniLM scores are not hosted Cohere quality measurements.
The four misses are rejected at the gate; this does not prove that lowering its threshold is a safe fix.
Window hashes/offsets refer to whitespace-normalized authored source chunks; source labels are authored page labels.
Frozen score regression replays do not run the neural models.
Known missing-attribute case ec04 does not refuse. The existing 10/10 refusal set does not represent all unsupported questions.
No answer generation, human semantic review, hosted inference, graph ablation, concurrency or production capacity measurement.
New eight-case holdout remains unrun. Historical h10 is a known regression, not fresh validation.
Existing PyMuPDF SWIG deprecation and isolated-test driver-resource warnings were observed. No external connection was exercised.
